Team — tagging in finance ops. Quick notes from our side: we require the following before changing the remit/payee in our billing system:

1) Completed W-9 (for US entity).
2) Certificate of Incorporation or formation documents showing the legal name match.
3) Bank details for new remittance if payments move off the existing account (routing, acct number, bank name, SWIFT if international).
4) Confirmation of whether prior invoices should be reissued. If yes, we need list of invoice numbers and amounts.

Operationally, we will:
- Put the account on a soft hold for automatic ACH on June 30 EOD to avoid mis-routing.
- Repoint invoice headers in our billing system on July 1 (once docs are validated).
- Reissue invoices only if requested by Spectral; otherwise payments will be applied to the outstanding balance under the new remit.

If the Spectral AP team expects expedited payments subject to the new remit, we can prioritize validation and request a sign-off from finance leadership.

Priyom — are there any procurement/contract implications related to the acquisition we should surface (pricing, PO scope, or billing address tied to existing contract)?

Thanks,
